children.value: > Fact From Story: Epic Games is set to go to trial with Google in hopes of convincing a jury that Google engages in anticompetitive behavior with regard to its Android app store, Google Play, and its commission structure.

> > Fact From Story: Epic plans to bring claims under Sections 1 and 2 of U.S. antitrust law, the Sherman Act, as well as California’s anticompetitive laws, the Cartwright Act, and the Unfair Competition Law.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Antitrust laws are designed to prevent anticompetitive behavior.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A trial is a way to resolve accusations of wrongdoing.
